notes:
Summary: Late-stage procurement, strong product fit for low-latency chat + personalization but lost to managed endpoints.

Key points from deal: quick POC; demo showed 45ms median token latency on short chat paths (good), but infra team penalized for cross-account KMS and extra ops. Security repeatedly said 'we need vendor-managed KMS + vendor identity federation' — AWS offered straight path to Bedrock + AWS KMS which removed blocker.

Quotes: 'We can't take on another ops stack; security wants everything in the cloud provider' (Director of Infra).

Engagement timeline: AE and SE heavy involvement; SE built a caching/kv demo; Redwood-proposed fallback routing wasn't high priority for them. Pricing: Redwood price (dedicated + private adders) looked ~25-35% higher than hyperscaler managed option for projected volume; procurement leveraged that heavily.

POC notes: latency + quality OK; security gap (HSM integration) and Ops cost were fatal. Internal champion left Jan 2026 — deal momentum collapsed.

Recommended follow-up: document postmortem with Jonah/AE, archive POC artifacts, set calendar reminder Aug 2026 to check infra review, prepare a tailored 'managed KMS bridge' brief explaining hybrid key options and TCO vs Bedrock.
